sovereign_country.strategic_role: 极速离岸证券与外汇交易商持牌（VFSC）、轻资产免税出海

business_scope.primary_industry_name: Ocean Vessel Freight and Wholesale Distribution of Hydraulic Cement

meta_jurisdiction_context.jurisdiction_name_en: Vanuatu (Republic of Vanuatu; Port Vila, Shefa Province, national unitary jurisdiction)
meta_jurisdiction_context.legal_system_doctrine: Hybrid (English common law and French civil law heritage, with Bislama as lingua franca and customary law as residual; codified offshore-companies regime administered by the Vanuatu Financial Services Commission)
applicable_bilateral_investment_treaties: Agreement between the Republic of Vanuatu and the People's Republic of China for the Promotion and Protection of Investments (signed 2006)
EU-Vanuatu interim Economic Partnership Agreement (iEPA, signed 2011; provisionally applied)
WTO Protocol of Accession (Vanuatu WTO member since 2012)
Pacific Agreement on Closer Economic Relations Plus (PACER-Plus, signed 2017; Vanuatu ratification completed 2020)
Melanesian Spearhead Group (MSG) Trade and Economic Agreement

ubo_and_aml_profiling.statutory_law_governance: International Companies Act [Cap. 222] (Revised Edition 2011, as amended); Financial Services Commission Act [Cap. 187]; Anti-Money Laundering and Counter-Terrorism Financing Act No. 13 of 2016 (as amended); VFSC AML/CFT Rule No. 1 of 2018 issued under the AML/CFT Act (CDD, record-keeping and reporting obligations for licensed registered agents and financial institutions); United Nations Act [Cap. 190] and subsidiary UN financial sanctions regulations; VFSC Schedule of Prescribed Fees.

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certified true copy of the valid passport or national identity card of each ultimate beneficial owner (UBO) and each director
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Issuing passport/identity authority of the UBO's country of nationality; apostille issued by the designated Competent Authority for the Hague Apostille Convention in that country, or by a Vanuatu diplomatic mission/honorary consulate where consular legalization applies
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille (or Consular Legalization where the country of origin is not party to the Apostille Convention)

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certificate of Good Standing / Certificate of Registration / Extract of Corporate Register of any corporate shareholder that is a UBO
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Companies registry or other competent corporate authority of the corporate shareholder's country of incorporation; apostille by the designated Competent Authority or Vanuatu consular legalization
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille (or Consular Legalization for non-Hague countries)

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Notarized Power of Attorney executed by each UBO, director and corporate shareholder appointing the Vanuatu licensed registered agent and legal counsel
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Notary Public in the country of execution; apostille by the designated Competent Authority or Vanuatu consular legalization
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille (or Consular Legalization for non-Hague countries)

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certified true copy of proof of residential/business address of each UBO and director (recent utility bill or bank statement, issued within the last 3 months)
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Utility provider or licensed bank of the relevant individual; notarized certification followed by apostille/consular legalization
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille (or Consular Legalization for non-Hague countries)

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Bank reference letter / professional third-party reference for each UBO confirming identity and standing in the applicant's home financial market
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Home-country licensed bank or regulated professional firm (lawyer, accountant) of the UBO; apostille/notarial attestation path as applicable
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille (or Consular Legalization for non-Hague countries)

ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: Mandatory risk-based CDD on all UBOs, directors, shareholders and counterparties before incorporation, including: (i) screening against the UN Security Council Consolidated Sanctions List as implemented domestically under the United Nations Act [Cap. 190] and subsidiary regulations; (ii) screening against FATF public statements, high-risk and monitored-jurisdiction lists; (iii) screening against VFSC administrative/disciplinary records and domestic designation lists administered by the Vanuatu Financial Services Commission and the National Compliance Investigations Unit (NCIU); (iv) PEP determination applying FATF Recommendation 12 standards, requiring enhanced due diligence including source of wealth and source of funds evidence where any PEP, family member or close associate is identified; and (v) as prudent market standard for SWIFT LC and TT wire payment rails, supplementary screening against OFAC SDN/Non-SDN lists and consolidated EU/UK sanctions lists. Given the low-risk wholesale construction-materials profile (ISIC 4663), standard CDD applies; any red flag triggers enhanced due diligence and escalation to the registered agent's compliance officer.

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.registry_portal_name: Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC) corporate registry - e-Services / Name Reservation portal (www.vfsc.vu); all name clearance submissions are made through a VFSC-licensed registered agent (mandatory intermediary).
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: Corporate names must be submitted in English (or Bislama) using Latin/Roman characters (A-Z, 0-9 and permitted punctuation). A name originating in a non-Roman script (e.g., Chinese, Arabic, Cyrillic) must be transliterated into Roman characters; registration in non-Latin script is not permitted. The name of an International Company must end with a limited-liability designator: 'Limited', 'Ltd', 'Corporation', 'Corp', 'Incorporated' or 'Inc'. Names must not be identical or confusingly similar to an existing or reserved name.
prohibited_and_sensitive_tokens: Any name implying or reasonably suggesting connection with the Government of the Republic of Vanuatu, a foreign government, a crown, a head of state, or any public authority
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: If the VFSC refuses the proposed name, the applicant (through the licensed registered agent) may (i) request a written statement of grounds for refusal; (ii) lodge a written reconsideration/administrative appeal with the VFSC within 14 calendar days of the refusal, attaching legal submissions and one alternative name; (iii) where the refusal is due to a prohibited financial token (e.g., 'Bank', 'Trust', 'Insurance'), obtain prior written consent from the relevant supervisory authority (e.g., Reserve Bank of Vanuatu) before re-submission; and (iv) if the refusal is upheld, institute judicial review proceedings before the Supreme Court of Vanuatu under the Civil Procedure Rules. A name reservation may be extended prior to expiry by filing a written renewal request with the prescribed fee; if the reservation expires, the name returns to availability and a fresh application is required.

registered_office_and_commercial_substan.virtual_office_permissibility: Permitted for administrative/back-office purposes only: a purely virtual registered office is not permitted, because the International Companies Act [Cap. 222] requires every IC to maintain at all times a physical registered office and a licensed registered agent in Vanuatu. In practice the registered office is the street address of the licensed registered agent in Port Vila. No physical trading premises, local staff or economic substance is mandated for a non-licensed wholesale trading IC engaged in ocean-vessel freight and wholesale distribution of hydraulic cement/clinker (ISIC 4663).
registered_office_and_commercial_substan.physical_inspection_likelihood: Low for the IC's own business premises and operations, quantified at approximately 2-5% annual probability given the non-licensed, low-risk wholesale commodity profile without local physical operations. Moderate-to-high for the licensed registered agent's office, quantified at approximately 40-60% inspection probability over a three-year cycle, as the VFSC conducts routine AML/CFT on-site examinations of all licensed international service providers and their registers.

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: VFSC Schedule of Prescribed Fees; statutory non-refundable tariff (approximately VUV 10,000)

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: VFSC incorporation registration fee and certificate of incorporation for an International Company
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: VFSC Schedule of Prescribed Fees; statutory tariff for International Company registration (approximately VUV 50,000)

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Mandatory licensed registered agent and registered office service (Year 1)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: VFSC-licensed international service provider / registered agent
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Prevailing Port Vila market tariff; includes registered office provision, agent statutory duties, AML/CFT compliance file maintenance and filings

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: External Vanuatu legal counsel: UBO piercing, PEP/sanctions screening, CDD file review, name clearance filing supervision and incorporation deliverables
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Market benchmark fixed fee for a low-risk wholesale trader International Company incorporation package

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Combined notary professional tariffs and MFA prescribed apostille/legalization fees for a five-document bundle

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: International courier delivery of apostilled original documents to Vanuatu
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Market courier rate for door-to-door express delivery to Port Vila, Vanuatu

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: International Companies Act [Cap 222] (Vanuatu), as amended by the International Companies (Amendment) Act No. 30 of 2019; key sections include s.1 (application and exemption from domestic tax), s.6 (powers of incorporation), s.7 (Certificate of Incorporation), s.9 (registered office), s.18 (memorandum of association), s.31 (directors), and s.45 (company secretary and officers).
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC) — Companies Registry, Port Vila, Vanuatu
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Memorandum and Articles of Association (M&A) filed via the eVFSC online portal together with the Application for Registration of an International Company and the Registered Agent's Compliance Certificate; incorporation is perfected by issuance of the Certificate of Incorporation.
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: No statutory minimum paid-up capital; share capital may be expressed in any currency and subscribed in full at incorporation; no escrow deposit or paid-up capital escrow account rule applies to a Vanuatu International Company.
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: RESOLVED THAT the allotment of 1,000 ordinary shares of USD 1.00 each, issued to the founding subscriber at par, be and is hereby ratified and recorded in the Register of Members, and non-resident beneficial ownership be approved. RESOLVED FURTHER THAT the registered office situated at the offices of the Registered Agent, Port Vila, Vanuatu, be adopted as the statutory registered office and the Registered Agent be retained. RESOLVED FURTHER THAT [Director Name] be appointed first Director and [Secretary Name] be appointed Secretary, each empowered severally to open bank mandates, execute trade or charter documents, and instruct professional advisers. RESOLVED FURTHER THAT the officers be authorized to file all statutory declarations with the Vanuatu Financial Services Commission and to adopt the common seal.

step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: VFSC Companies Registry — eVFSC Online Portal (submitted via approved Registered Agent)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Conduct a preliminary name search across the Registrar's prohibited-name database; submit the Name Reservation Application with up to three proposed corporate names together with the non-resident shareholder's certified passport copy; obtain the electronic name reservation certificate before incorporation.
required_dossiers: Certified passport copy of proposed shareholder/director
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the proposed name is refused as conflicting, misleading, or offensive, the applicant may resubmit with alternative names within 14 days; the first re-submission is processed without an additional government fee.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Drafting and Execution of Constitutional Documents
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: VFSC-approved Registered Agent / Corporate Services Provider
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Prepare the Memorandum and Articles of Association aligned with the International Companies Act model articles, including the object clause for ocean vessel freight and wholesale distribution of hydraulic cement and portland clinker; execute the M&A by each subscriber and obtain consent to act from the first directors, secretary, and registered agent.
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: Any defect in the M&A is remedied by drafting an amendment; the registered agent refiles corrected pages with VFSC before the incorporation application is lodged.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Submission of Incorporation Application and Compliance Declaration
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Vanuatu Financial Services Commission — Companies Registry, Port Vila
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: The registered agent submits the incorporation application electronically via eVFSC, attaching the executed M&A, declaration of compliance by the applicant, and agent certificate confirming each subscriber's identity and source of funds; VFSC validates statutory compliance, corporate name availability, and registered office requirements on a first-come, first-served basis.
required_dossiers: Application for Registration of an International Company (Form 2)
Executed Memorandum and Articles of Association
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the application is queried, the registered agent corrects the noted deficiencies and refiles within 14 business days; matters of legal interpretation are addressed by written submission to the VFSC Legal Department.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Statutory Fee Payment and Issuance of Certificate of Incorporation
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: VFSC Registry Cashier / eVFSC Payment Gateway
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Pay the prescribed incorporation fee of USD 475 (or Vatu equivalent) via bank wire or e-payment; VFSC stamps the M&A and issues the Certificate of Incorporation, upon which the company acquires separate legal personality with limited liability on the date stated in the certificate.
required_dossiers: Stamped Memorandum and Articles of Association
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the certificate contains typographical errors or issuance is delayed, the applicant files a rectification request with VFSC; re-issuance is completed within 3 business days at no additional fee.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Post-Incorporation Governance and Registered Office Records
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Convene the first board meeting; adopt the first board resolution approving the registered office, share allotment, and officer appointments; prepare share certificates, statutory registers (register of members, directors, and charges), and the company seal; file the beneficial ownership register with VFSC within the statutory window.
required_dossiers: Registered Agent acceptance of statutory filings
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: Defective minutes or registers are cured by a subsequent written board resolution ratified within 30 days; late beneficial ownership filings are corrected through a VFSC voluntary compliance notice and payment of the applicable late fee.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: Department of Industry — Ministry of Trade, Tourism, Industry and Commerce, Vanuatu
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: Business Licence under the Business Licence Act [Cap 243] — required only if the International Company conducts physical on-island storage, warehousing, or local distribution; an International Company registered under the International Companies Act is exempt from the domestic business licence while conducting offshore wholesale and ocean vessel freight activities.

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.agency_name: Department of Environmental Protection and Conservation (DEPC), Ministry of Climate Change Adaptation, Meteorology, Geo-Hazards, Energy, Environment and Disaster Management
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Category B — Preliminary Environmental Assessment (PEA) required for bulk cement and portland clinker storage and handling facilities; a Full Environmental Impact Assessment (EIA) Report is required for wharf-side transshipment terminals with annual throughput exceeding 20,000 tonnes or located within 200 metres of sensitive coastal receptors.
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: Zero discharge of cement kiln dust or clinker fines into marine waters; compliance with the Marine Pollution (Prevention of Pollution of the Sea) Act [Cap 132] and Vanuatu General Water Quality Standards for coastal discharge; dust suppression via covered storage silos, bag filters, and wheel-wash systems; hazardous waste manifesting per DEPC waste disposal guidelines.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: Fire Safety Certificate from the Vanuatu Police Force Fire and Emergency Services; structural load inspection and works approval from the Public Works Department (PWD); workplace registration and occupational safety clearance under the Employment Act [Cap 160] and the Health and Safety at Work Act; port facility security clearance from the Vanuatu Maritime and Ports Authority for any shore-side cargo handling operation.

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: Vanuatu Customs and Inland Revenue Department (VCIRD), Ministry of Finance and Economic Management; taxpayer registration and filing portal accessible via https://www.vancustoms.gov.vu and the VCIRD online taxpayer services portal, with customs export processing through the ASYCUDA World national single window.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: A foreign-owned International Company (IC) obtains a Taxpayer Identification Number (TIN) by submitting the VCIRD TIN Application Form accompanied by: certified copy of the Certificate of Incorporation issued under the International Companies Act [Cap 222]; Memorandum and Articles of Association; registered office consent letter from the licensed Vanuatu registered agent; and KYC documents (passport, proof of address, and beneficial ownership declaration) for each director and ultimate beneficial owner. Applications are lodged online via the VCIRD portal or in person at Port Vila or Luganville offices; the TIN is ordinarily issued within 3-7 business days. Where the IC undertakes taxable supplies of goods in Vanuatu or opts to claim export zero-rating, it must additionally complete VAT registration (Form VAT-R) under the same TIN, either compulsorily when annual taxable turnover exceeds VT 10,000,000 or voluntarily when below threshold.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: Vanuatu has no check-the-box, disregarded-entity, or other elective entity-classification regime. An International Company is statutorily exempt from all national income tax, corporate tax, capital gains tax, stamp duty, withholding tax, and VAT on international business activities by operation of section 24 of the International Companies Act [Cap 222]. No hybrid-mismatch or look-through election is available or required; the IC files only the annual VFSC compliance returns and does not file a domestic income tax return.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.indirect_tax_system_name: Value Added Tax (VAT) under the Value Added Tax Act [Cap 249], as amended
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: VT 10,000,000 of annual taxable turnover (mandatory registration); voluntary registration is expressly permitted below the threshold for exporters and persons supplying zero-rated goods or services such as ocean freight of export cargo.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: Vanuatu does not operate a real-time fiscal clearance, government API pre-clearance, continuous transaction control, or digital stamping mandate. A VAT-registered person must issue tax invoices (paper or secure PDF) containing the statutory particulars under the VAT Act: supplier name and TIN, purchaser name and TIN, invoice date, description and quantity of goods, value, applicable VAT amount, and, for zero-rated exports, the basis of zero-rating together with reference to the underlying customs export declaration. Customs export procedures are transacted electronically through ASYCUDA World.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: Zero-rating is available under the VAT Act for: (i) goods physically exported from Vanuatu by the registered supplier within the prescribed timeframe, including bulk Portland cement clinker shipped by ocean vessel to non-resident wholesale buyers; (ii) international freight, shipping, and transport services in respect of such export goods; and (iii) services supplied to a non-resident who is outside Vanuatu when the service is physically performed and the direct benefit of which is enjoyed wholly outside Vanuatu. The supplier must retain full documentary evidence of export and separately record zero-rated sales in the periodic VAT return; input VAT incurred on export-related purchases (port handling, inland haulage, vessel charter inputs, and agency fees) is creditable or refundable to the extent attributable to zero-rated turnover.
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: Customs Export Declaration (ASYCUDA World electronic export declaration, assessed and cleared by VCIRD Customs)
Ocean Bill of Lading (issued to non-resident consignee, evidencing the outbound movement of clinker from a Vanuatu port)
Commercial invoice and packing list (HS Code of Portland clinker, quantity, Incoterms 2020, vessel name and voyage number)
Certificate of Origin (where required by the destination customs authority)
Inward Remittance Certificate / bank foreign exchange records evidencing receipt of export sale proceeds from the non-resident buyer
Input VAT invoices for export-attributable purchases and the supporting VAT return schedules
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: Under the VAT Act and related VCIRD enforcement practice, any export zero-rating claim that is false, inflated, or unsubstantiated attracts: immediate retrospective clawback of the VAT refund together with additional tax of 25% per annum on the underpaid amount; monetary fines of up to VT 5,000,000 per offence for the company and its officers; imprisonment of up to 10 years for directors or managers involved in fraudulent evasion; and possible suspension or cancellation of the TIN and VAT registration. Upon audit, VCIRD may require production of the complete export documentation bundle within 14 days; failure to substantiate the physical export, the foreign consignee, or the receipt of proceeds reverses the zero-rating from the original filing date with penalty tax accruing accordingly.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_authority: Reserve Bank of Vanuatu (RBV), acting as the central bank and monetary authority under the Reserve Bank Act [Cap. 125], with the Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC) responsible for International Company licensing and registry supervision. Vanuatu has no separate exchange-control administration.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: Vanuatu operates a freely convertible currency system. There is no general exchange-control act, no central bank approval requirement for current-account or capital-account flows, and no blanket restriction on foreign-currency holdings or remittances. The Vatu is fully convertible through licensed commercial banks. Capital contributions, dividend distributions, liquidation proceeds, profit repatriation, and outward loan repayments are not subject to statutory convertibility hurdles. Actual operational constraints are limited to the relatively shallow offshore VUV market and the correspondent-banking compliance thresholds imposed by international partner banks.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: Vanuatu imposes no statutory export-proceeds surrender timeline and no mandatory conversion ratio to Vatu. Export receipts may be retained in the original invoiced currency, converted at freely negotiated commercial rates, or credited to a foreign-currency operational account. Licensed banks apply only general anti-money-laundering, counter-terrorist financing, sanctions screening, and know-your-customer due diligence under the Anti-Money Laundering and Countering the Financing of Terrorism Act [Cap. 261] and RBV directives.

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.account_class: Operational Account for export receipts, trade disbursements, and treasury pooling; separate Capital Escrow Account for initial equity contribution
Operational Account in VUV/USD/AUD for bulk-cement trade settlements; Capital Escrow Account for share capital
Operational Account for USD/EUR clearing and documentary letter-of-credit facilities; Capital Escrow Account for inbound investment
Operational Account for global SWIFT payments and foreign-currency hedging; Capital Escrow Account if required by global AML policy

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: Low. Vanuatu does not maintain a regulated electronic-money institution or payment-service provider licensing class distinct from commercial banks. Cross-border digital EMIs and non-bank payment platforms cannot obtain a local Vanuatu licence and are not acceptable as principal clearing or settlement entities for the IC treasury structure. Such platforms may be used only as supplementary invoicing/conversion conveniences, never as primary liquidity rails, because they create unlicensed payment-services exposure and weaken the local banking nexus. All regulated settlement must remain with a Vanuatu licensed commercial bank or its licensed foreign correspondents.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: Physical or branch-level identity verification is effectively mandatory for non-resident-owned International Companies. In practice, licensed banks require at least one natural-person director, the ultimate beneficial owner, or a fully authorized signatory to attend a face-to-face interview at a Vanuatu branch. Remote opening is not prohibited by statute but is commercially unavailable without a pre-existing banking relationship or an existing approved VFSC-registered agent relationship. The registered agent must countersign the corporate KYC file, and notarized passports, original certified registry extracts, board resolutions, and detailed source-of-wealth declarations must be delivered before account activation.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Opaque ultimate beneficial ownership or nominee-director arrangements
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Complete organizational chart of the International Company; certified copies of share register and register of directors; registered agent CDD file; declaration of trust or nominee agreement; passport and proof of residential address for each natural-person UBO; board resolution identifying the controller and source of funds.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Tax-exempt offshore structure with no apparent local economic substance
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Current International Company certificate and articles of incorporation; VFSC good-standing certificate; written business plan for the clinker wholesale and ocean-freight trading corporation; evidence of trade contracts, charter party agreements, bills of lading, and commercial invoices; registered office and registered agent confirmation; statement of intended foreign operations outside Vanuatu.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: High-value commodity-trade payment flows inconsistent with declared turnover
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Audited or internally reviewed financial statements; sales/purchase contracts for Portland clinker; pro-forma invoices; full shipping documentation including vessel name, IMO number, port of loading, port of discharge, draft survey, and weight certificate; warehouse and insurance documents; SWIFT payment trail matching invoice values.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Sanctions or adverse-media exposure on counterparties, vessels, or transshipment jurisdictions
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Sanctions screening reports against UN, EU, OFAC, and HMT lists; certificates of origin for the clinker cargo; vessel flag registry and port-call history; end-user and unrelated-party undertakings; denial of intended business with restricted ports or entities; legal opinion on the transaction's compliance with applicable export-control and sanctions regimes.

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: Shareholder equity is routed by SWIFT MT103 from the investing shareholder's bank to the IC's Capital Escrow or Operational Account at a Vanuatu licensed bank. The remittance instruction must clearly state the economic purpose as 'contribution to share capital' or 'paid-in capital injection'. No Reserve Bank of Vanuatu exchange-control approval is required. The supporting compliance file must include the execution board resolution, share subscription agreement, updated share register, source-of-funds evidence, and the registered agent's KYC confirmation. Standard clearing acceptance is one to two banking days after compliance clearance.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: For Portland clinker bulk imports and ocean-freight settlements, the primary clearing rails are SWIFT MT103 for cash-against-documents and documentary letters of credit (MT700/MT720) for supplier-guaranteed trade settlement. Supplier payments under commercial letters of credit are made through SWIFT MT202 cover or MT103 reimbursement after compliant presentation of bill of lading, commercial invoice, certificate of origin, quality certificate, and insurance documents. Ancillary disbursements for demurrage, port dues, loading/discharging fees, surveyor costs, and freight-deferral balances are executed by MT103 with contract and vessel reference. All international trade clearing is settled in USD, AUD, EUR, or CNY rather than VUV, with VUV used only for domestic operating payments if required.
permissible_fx_hedging_instruments: Deliverable foreign-exchange forward contracts against VUV/USD, VUV/AUD, VUV/EUR, and VUV/CNY with a Vanuatu licensed bank
Offshore nondeliverable forward contracts on VUV arranged through the bank's correspondent network
Cross-currency swaps matching trade-payable and receivable currency legs
Plain vanilla foreign-exchange options and caps on USD/AUD/CNY trade settlement flows
Foreign-exchange swaps for short-dated liquidity repositioning between the Vanuatu operational account and the offshore settlement currency account

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Government Licence Fee Renewal and Continued Registration Confirmation
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC) – International Companies Registry
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Anniversary of incorporation; renewal payment must be received by VFSC on or before the anniversary date.
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late payment after the anniversary triggers a statutory late penalty and loss of good standing; continued non-payment permits VFSC to issue a strike-off notice, and administrative dissolution follows if the default is not remedied within the notice period. Restoration requires payment of all arrears, penalties, and any applicable restoration fee.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Beneficial Ownership Confirmation and UBO Register Update
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: VFSC and Vanuatu Financial Intelligence Unit through the registered agent; no public filing.
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Anniversary of incorporation; in addition, the register must be updated immediately upon any share transfer or change in the beneficial ownership chain.
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Failure to maintain and update the beneficial ownership register is an offence under Vanuatu beneficial ownership legislation; monetary penalties may be imposed, the registered agent may cease to act, and persistent non-compliance contributes to VFSC administrative strike-off proceedings.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Statutory Register Verification and VFSC Inspection Readiness Declaration
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Registered agent on behalf of VFSC; no separate filing if registers are properly maintained at the registered office.
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: At the incorporation anniversary; all statutory registers must be current and available for VFSC inspection at all times.
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Defective or unavailable statutory registers constitute an offence under the International Companies Act, subject to fines and, for continued default, administrative strike-off.

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: No compulsory audit thresholds apply to a non-licensed Vanuatu International Company. A statutory audit is not required solely by revenue, assets, or shareholder count. Independent audit becomes mandatory only if the International Company holds a VFSC financial services licence or if an audit is required by shareholder resolution, bank covenant, or counterparty due diligence.
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: The International Companies Act requires accounting records sufficient to explain transactions and give a true and fair view; it does not mandate IFRS or local GAAP for an exempt International Company. Voluntary financial statements should be prepared under IFRS, and any audit should be performed in accordance with International Standards on Auditing.

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: Beneficial ownership information is not publicly filed. The registered agent must identify, verify, and record every ultimate beneficial owner at incorporation and then re-confirm the register on each anniversary by obtaining a current declaration from the directors. Each share transfer must be reflected in the register of members and in the UBO register before the transfer is perfected; the annual confirmation restates the full current ownership chain, including name, date of birth, nationality, residential address, and nature and percentage of interest.
mandatory_on_site_statutory_registers: Minute Book of shareholder and director resolutions
Certificate of Incorporation, Memorandum, and Articles of Association

recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.registered_office_or_agent_market_range_: USD 700 – USD 1,200 per year (registered agent fee, registered office, board minute preparation, and statutory register maintenance)
recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.statutory_audit_estimated_fee_usd: No statutory audit applies to a standard International Company; voluntary certified audit market range USD 3,000 – USD 6,000 per engagement.

corporate_income_tax_regime.statutory_headline_rate: 0% - Vanuatu imposes no corporate income tax; International Companies are statutorily exempt from all Vanuatu income tax, VAT, stamp duty, capital gains tax, and withholding taxes under s.3 of the International Companies Act [Cap 222].
corporate_income_tax_regime.effective_tax_rate_incentives: 0% effective rate for a compliant International Company; no statutory tax holidays are necessary because the exemption is permanent while the annual VFSC licence fee is current and the company refrains from prohibited local business with Vanuatu residents or local landholding.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: VFSC Form 12 (Annual Return of an International Company) under ss.73 and 111 of the International Companies Act [Cap 222]; filed electronically by the VFSC-licensed registered agent through the MyVFSC e-Registry portal (https://myvfsc.vu).
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: Within 60 days after each anniversary of the date of incorporation. A company incorporated on 15 March must file its annual return by 14 May of each year.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Box 1 - Company Name and Registration Number
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Full legal name of the International Company exactly as stated in the Certificate of Incorporation and the VFSC company number.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Non-resident beneficial owners must ensure the exact English legal name is used; any abbreviation, transliteration, or name variant invalidates the filing and may render the document ineffective for banking and due diligence purposes.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Physical street address of the registered office maintained in Port Vila by the VFSC-licensed registered agent.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: The registered agent supplies the registered office address; a post-office box alone is not a valid registered office. The address cannot be changed retroactively for tax residence purposes.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Name, licence number, and signature of the VFSC-licensed registered agent authorised to represent the company.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Non-resident shareholders must retain a licensed agent; the agent signs and submits the return and acts as the statutory point of service for legal process.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Full names, residential addresses, nationality, dates of appointment, and identification numbers of all directors.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Nominee directors are permitted under Vanuatu law, but the ultimate beneficial owner must still be disclosed to the registered agent and recorded in the company's internal register as required by the Beneficial Ownership Act 2017.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Authorised share capital, par value per class, number of issued shares, and names of registered shareholders.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: If bearer shares exist, they must be physically immobilised with the registered agent; for CRS/AEOI compliance agents commonly insist on conversion to registered shares before the annual return is accepted.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Statutory declaration confirming that during the reporting year the company did not carry on business with Vanuatu residents, did not hold or lease land in Vanuatu, and did not engage in any activity prohibited by the International Companies Act.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: This declaration is compulsory for the zero-tax status. A false declaration is an offence under s.120 of the IC Act and is independently reportable to the Vanuatu Financial Intelligence Unit.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Late filing surcharge of VT 20,000 (approx. USD 170) per month of delay plus a 20% surcharge on the unpaid annual licence fee; continued default beyond 12 months entitles the Registrar to strike the company off under ss.109-112 of the IC Act, whereupon all company assets vest in the Government and the company's legal existence terminates.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: VFSC Beneficial Ownership (BO) Confirmation Return under the Beneficial Ownership Act 2017 and the International Companies (Amendment) Act 2018; submitted by the registered agent through MyVFSC.
tax_return_filing_anatomy.reporting_frequency: Annual, and upon any change in ownership or control
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: Mandatory at incorporation, simultaneously with the annual return (60 days after the anniversary of incorporation), and within 14 days of any change in the register of significant controllers or beneficial owners.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Full legal name, date of birth, nationality, residential address, and tax identification number of each natural person who ultimately owns or controls 25% or more of the company.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Non-resident shareholders must provide certified identity documents (passport and proof of address) to the agent; reliance on corporate ownership layers does not remove the disclosure duty and each intermediate layer must be identified until a natural person is reached.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Item B - Nature and Extent of Interest
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Percentage of shares, voting rights, and the mechanism of control (direct, indirect, nominee, trust, or other arrangement).
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Trust structures require identification of the settlor, trustee, protector, and beneficiaries; failure to disclose a trust interest is treated as a deliberate false return.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Item C - Source of Funds Statement
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Brief declaration of the source of subscription funds for the issued shares, disclosing the originating jurisdiction and intermediary banks.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: For a Portland clinker wholesale trade vehicle, the source of funds must be consistent with commercial invoices, bills of lading, and LC disbursements; undocumented cash introductions trigger mandatory suspicious matter reporting to the Vanuatu FIU.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Non-filing or false filing of the BO Return attracts a corporate fine of up to VT 500,000 (approx. USD 4,250) and a personal fine of up to VT 100,000 (approx. USD 850) per director, plus a daily default penalty of VT 10,000 (approx. USD 85) per day of continued contravention; the Registrar may also suspend or revoke the registered agent's licence.

profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.statutory_dividend_wht_rate: 0% - Vanuatu imposes no withholding tax on dividends declared or paid by an International Company to any shareholder, resident or non-resident, and no currency or capital controls restrict the repatriation of dividend proceeds except for AML verification of the receiving bank account.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.treaty_relief_application_protocol: Vanuatu has no comprehensive double taxation agreement network and does not issue income-tax residency certificates because no income tax code exists. No treaty relief form or TRC is therefore required for outbound dividends. To satisfy foreign remittance banks and the shareholder's tax authority, the company should obtain from the VFSC a Certificate of Good Standing and certified Certificate of Incorporation, accompanied by a legal opinion citing s.3 of the International Companies Act confirming the statutory tax exemption. Relief from foreign withholding tax, if any, depends entirely on the shareholder's domestic law and applicable foreign CFC/attribution rules, not on any Vanuatu administrative procedure.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.cross_border_royalty_and_interest_wht: 0% statutory and effective rate for both intellectual-property royalties and debt interest paid by a Vanuatu International Company to non-residents; no treaty rates apply because Vanuatu maintains no comprehensive income tax treaties. Interest and royalty payments are, however, reportable financial flows subject to CRS/AEOI and to the foreign lender's or licensor's own domestic taxation.

transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.tp_documentation_threshold_local_currenc: Not applicable - Vanuatu has no domestic transfer-pricing legislation, no Local File or Master File obligations, and no transactional thresholds. For a wholesale cement and clinker distribution group, the relevant documentation thresholds are those of the parent and market jurisdictions (e.g., OECD-aligned rules generally require a Local File where related-party cross-border transactions exceed USD 1 million, and a Master File where group turnover exceeds USD 850 million). The Vanuatu IC must nevertheless maintain contemporaneous pricing evidence for its purchase and resale of Portland clinker to substantiate arm's length treatment before foreign auditors.
transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.economic_substance_doctrine: Vanuatu has not enacted an Economic Substance (Companies and Limited Partnerships) Act in the BVI/Cayman model. However, an International Company must maintain a registered agent and registered office in Port Vila, keep accounting records, and file beneficial ownership data under the Beneficial Ownership Act 2017. Vanuatu is presently included on the EU list of non-cooperative jurisdictions for tax purposes, and foreign tax authorities will apply their own economic substance, CFC, and GAAR rules to re-characterise the Vanuatu IC as a sham if management and control or core profit-generating functions for the clinker trade occur in a high-tax market country. A passively held VU IC with a licensed agent, proper board minutes, and genuine contractual documentation will withstand scrutiny; a paper-only shell will not.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: Foreign Tax Evasion via Offshore Billing (CFC / CRS Mismatch)
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Using the Vanuatu International Company as the invoicing and bank-account holding vehicle for Portland clinker wholesale sales to Australian, New Zealand, or other high-tax market customers, while all board decisions, contracting, and risk management occur in the market country and the foreign UBO fails to declare the VU-generated profit in the jurisdiction of tax residence.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Vanuatu itself has no income tax sanction, but Vanuatu has participated in the OECD Common Reporting Standard and Automatic Exchange of Information since 2018 and will exchange financial account data with treaty partners. In the shareholder's home jurisdiction the consequence is deliberate tax evasion: increased assessments of up to 200% of the tax evaded, criminal fines, compensatory interest, and forfeiture orders covering the full value of the hidden offshore account.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors who signed false foreign tax returns or directed the sham billing arrangement are personally liable for civil restitution of the unpaid tax and may face criminal prosecution with travel bans, asset freezes, and imprisonment of up to 10 years under typical foreign tax fraud statutes; courts will pierce the Vanuatu corporate veil because the IC is a mere instrumentality of the controlling shareholder.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: Shell Company / Lack of Economic Substance
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Maintaining the International Company with a nominee director who has no actual authority, with no board meetings, no minutes, no bank account in the company's own name, no purchase orders, no bills of lading, and no underlying sale contracts for the bulk clinker trade, so that the company is paper-only.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Under the International Companies Act [Cap 222], continuing failure to maintain a registered office and agent, or filing false compliance declarations, attracts a fine of up to VT 1,000,000 (approx. USD 8,500) plus a daily default fine of VT 10,000 (approx. USD 85) per day. The Registrar may strike the company off, causing all assets to vest in the Government. Internationally, EU listing and OECD substance requirements compel banks and counter-parties to treat the entity as non-compliant, resulting in account closure and the denial of treaty or withholding benefits.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: The nominee director is personally liable for the local fines; foreign tax courts will disregard the entity and impose the full tax liability on the UBO, authorising seizure of personal assets and restraint orders over director bank accounts in the market jurisdiction.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Routing payments through the Vanuatu entity using fabricated shipping documents, over-invoicing or under-invoicing of clinker, paying fictitious agency commissions to connected third-party accounts, or moving funds with no supporting bills of lading and no AML/KYC onboarding records.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Contravention of the Anti-Money Laundering and Counter-Terrorism Financing Act No. 13 of 2018: a body corporate is liable to a fine of up to VT 20,000,000 (approx. USD 170,000); a natural person is liable to a fine of up to VT 10,000,000 (approx. USD 85,000) or imprisonment for up to 12 years, or both. The Vanuatu FIU and VFSC may freeze accounts, revoke the registered agent's licence, and confiscate the proceeds under the Proceeds of Crime Act.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors and beneficial owners are jointly and severally liable for the corporate fine; restraint orders, travel bans, and asset confiscation orders apply to personal property; directors are extraditable under mutual legal assistance arrangements to the foreign market country where the underlying customs or value-added tax fraud occurred.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: Failure to File Annual Return and Pay Annual Licence Fee
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Missing the 60-day anniversary filing window for the VFSC Form 12 Annual Return and failing to pay the government annual licence fee for 12 consecutive months, often because the registered agent was not retained or the UBO ignored renewal notices.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: A late penalty of VT 20,000 per month of delay plus a 20% surcharge on the unpaid licence fee; after 12 months of continued default the Registrar may strike the company off under ss.109-112 of the IC Act, at which point all company assets automatically vest in the Registrar for sale or disposal in favour of the Government of Vanuatu.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: After striking-off, the limitation of liability ceases and each director is jointly and severally liable for all company debts and obligations incurred after the strike-off; the Supreme Court may impose disqualification orders of up to 5 years preventing the directors from acting in any company in Vanuatu.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: Prohibited Local Business and VAT Evasion
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Using the International Company to buy or sell goods in Vanuatu's domestic market, lease warehouses, or hold real property in Vanuatu, without converting to a local company and without registering for the Vanuatu Value Added Tax of 12.5%.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: The IC Act prohibits International Companies from carrying on business with Vanuatu residents, owning land, or holding leases other than the registered office lease. Contravention attracts a fine of up to VT 1,000,000 (approx. USD 8,500) and a daily default fine of VT 50,000 (approx. USD 425), the loss of tax-exemption for the offending transaction, and retrospective assessment of 12.5% VAT plus late penalties of up to 25% of the tax due by the Vanuatu Revenue and Customs Authority.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors who knowingly authorised the local transaction are personally liable for the unpaid VAT, the penalty, and any tax default interest; making a false declaration to the Commissioner of Revenue is a criminal offence carrying imprisonment of up to 2 years, and directors may be removed from office by court order.
